description: Defines the 'Fence' class for synchronization primitives in Android, including methods for managing fence file descriptors, waiting, merging, and retrieving signal times.

classes.name: Fence
classes.description: Represents a synchronization fence with methods for managing and querying fence state.

methods.name: isValidTimestamp
methods.description: Checks if a timestamp is valid (non-negative and less than INT64_MAX).

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the fence to signal within a specified timeout.

methods.name: waitForever
methods.description: Waits indefinitely for the fence to signal, with logging.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Creates a new fence that signals when both input fences have signaled.

methods.name: dup
methods.description: Returns a duplicate of the fence's file descriptor.

methods.name: getSignalTime
methods.description: Returns the system time when the fence signaled.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the fence (Invalid, Unsignaled, Signaled).
